title: Assistant Director (OG-2) - SBOTS 27th Batch
education: Master's or Bachelor's Degree (16 years of education) in Business Administration, Public Administration, Economics, Finance, Commerce, Data Science, or IT
source: State Bank Official Portal & National Newspapers
description: The State Bank of Pakistan invites applications for Assistant Directors under the State Bank Officers Training Scheme (SBOTS). Selected candidates will undergo comprehensive residential training at the National Institute of Banking and Finance (NIBAF) prior to placement in key monetary policy, banking supervision, and digital finance departments.
requirements: Maximum age limit 26 years as of deadline date (relaxed by 3 years for candidates from Gilgit-Baltistan, AJK, & Balochistan)

Pakistani nationality required; competitive selection via written testing agency and departmental interview

Physical Standards: Height 5 ft 6 in for males, 5 ft 2 in for females; Chest measurement 32-33.5 inches (males)
